text: With the stack and the data flow planned, we size the ingestion path itself against Caldera's real installation count.
About 17 readings a second across 5,000 installations -- a sliver of one shard's capacity -- but we provision 2 shards anyway, for growth headroom and parallel consumption, keyed on installation_id.
Lambda batches up to 100 records or 30 seconds, whichever comes first, targeting under two minutes from an inverter's reading to a readable object in raw.
We name one tradeoff in writing: at-least-once delivery can duplicate a batch on retry. That's accepted here and resolved downstream, not fought at the ingestion layer.
The ingestion path is sized. Next: the first real terraform apply.
